notes.title: The Sinister Set VR Horror Collection
notes.notes:
Do you dare to overcome your fears and confront true evil as an Exorcist? Or become one of the restless undead, stuck in the afterlife? How about being deprived of your memories inside an abandoned skyscraper, or getting trapped in a dying spaceship? Maybe try to escape a haunted manor, or explore the derelict towns and run-down motels in America's deep south?

Now you get to do all this and more in [b]The Sinister Six[/b]: a bone-chilling collection of VR games no horror fan should miss!

Includes the following six titles, or the ones you do not own yet:
[list]
[b][*] The Exorcist: Legion VR
[*] Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife
[*] AFFECTED: The Manor
[*] Cosmodread
[*] Hinge
[*] A Chair in a Room: Greenwater[/b]
[/list]

Check out the bundle here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/[/url]

notes.title: Helloooo? Pick up the radio Detective...
notes.notes:
There has been a large influx of Quest 2 players and we've implemented formal support for the latest touch controllers. This includes resolving an issue with the radio in the police precinct which was preventing players from beginning Chapter 1. Thank you for the user feedback helping us track down this issue, and welcome to all the Quest 2 players!

The game is also available on the Oculus Quest store.👀

What other updates would you like to see?  Please let us know in the comments.  Many thanks to fans such as [url=https://youtu.be/7eMzPlohtbA]@anaburnofficial[/url] for sending incredible artwork and Mixed Reality playthroughs.

notes.title: Small bug fix for Index users
notes.notes: Wolf and Wood pushed out a new update affecting a small number of Index users whereby the world would disappear after finding the crucifix and tape recordings for the first time.   If you still encounter this issue after the update, please reach out to us at [url=https://www.exorcistlegion.com/bugs]Bug Report[/url]

notes.title: Mixed Reality Now Supported!
notes.notes:
[b]It's the witching season, especially for Mixed Reality enthusiasts and Halloween content creators.  🎃[/b]

Today we have rolled out an update to the Deluxe Edition which adds full MR support, powered by LIV (available free on Steam)  Please check out our new MR trailer for an example of what to expect on your journey to expel Pazuzu and his Legion.

[previewyoutube=uoCzthZK8s8;full][previewyoutube=uoCzthZK8s8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Controller Bug Fixes & WMR Headset Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35897653/6c6224a28765f54803d69b903dc56686e8d7f4fc.png[/img]

Hello Exorcists!  We just rolled out an update for the Deluxe Edition yesterday. Please make sure you download this patch the next time you log in.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue whereby some controllers would stop working after picking up the Holy Water in Episode 1 "First Rites" has been fixed.
[*] For those who prefer snap turn over free turning, swipe rotation on the Vive wands has been fixed.
[*] We now fully support WMR headsets and controller support has been added!
[/list]

[i]in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti...[/i]

notes.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR (Deluxe Edition) releases today.
notes.notes:
Today we're happy to announce the release of The Exorcist: Legion VR (Deluxe Edition) which contains all FIVE episodes and enhanced demonic textures and animations.  This edition includes Index controller support, optimizations for Rift S headsets, and movement upgrades.  If you haven't yet tried the individual episodes, the Deluxe Edition is definitely for you!
